{{Quote|Of course you've never lost everything.''"<br />"''Not everything, no. But I've had my share of losses.''"<br />"''What, promotions? The last dessert cube in the mess line?|Sorro and Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="COO" />}}
A '''dessert cube''' was a food [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and served in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] mess halls<ref name="COO" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> during [[Nuso Esva|Lord Odo's]] visit to<ref name="COO" /> the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="HttES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] had a conversation with Odo's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Sorro]], in which the latter mockingly compared Pellaeon's losses to as small a thing as not getting a dessert cube.<ref name="COO" />

==Behind the scenes==
A dessert cube was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="COO" />
